description: This file defines the OrderProductAttribute entity class, representing attributes associated with an order product in an e-commerce application. It maps to the ORDER_PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTE table in the database, with fields for price, weight, option IDs, attribute names, and linking to the OrderProduct entity.

classes.name: OrderProductAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing attributes of an order product, including attributes like price, weight, options, and associated order product.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the order product attribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the order product attribute.

methods.name: isProductAttributeIsFree
methods.description: Returns whether the attribute is free.

methods.name: setProductAttributeIsFree
methods.description: Sets the free status of the attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the product attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the product attribute.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Associates an OrderProduct entity with this attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributeValueName
methods.description: Returns the value name of the product attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeValueName
methods.description: Sets the value name of the product attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Returns the price associated with the attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Sets the price for the attribute.

methods.name: getProductOptionId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product option.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product option value.
